description: Defines a sealed class SyncStatus representing various synchronization states for the app, with different subclasses indicating idle, running, success, and error states.

classes.name: SyncStatus
classes.description: Represents various synchronization states for the app, used for UI updates and diagnostics.

methods.name: Idle
methods.description: Represents the idle state when no sync is occurring.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Represents successful completion of sync with timestamp.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Represents an error state with an associated message.
